selected.reason: Retain the original full-extent draft. Local seed heights alone fail the direction guard; local heights with bounded XY fitting export but do not improve sampled support, and lane segmentation differs. Do not adopt an ineffective estimator change. Keep eight source-review lanes and unresolved layout/ground-level/accuracy holds visible.

conclusion: The local seed-height estimator did not improve NCLT. Preserve baseline; observed low heights are not verified road levels or evidence that Z-only correction is appropriate.
